n, m, mod = map(int, input().split())

MAX = 505

# Initialize combination table
comb = [[0] * MAX for _ in range(MAX)]
for i in range(MAX):
    comb[i][0] = 1
    comb[i][i] = 1
    for j in range(1, i):
        comb[i][j] = (comb[i-1][j-1] + comb[i-1][j]) % mod

# Initialize f1 and f2
f1 = [0] * MAX
f2 = [0] * MAX
f1[0] = 1

for i in range(1, MAX):
    for j in range(1, n+1):
        f1[i] = (f1[i] + f1[j-1] * f1[i - j] % mod * comb[i - 1][j - 1]) % mod
    f1[i] = (i + 1) * f1[i] % mod

for i in range(1, MAX):
    for j in range(1, n+1):
        sum_val = 0
        for k in range(1, j+1):
            sum_val = (sum_val + f1[k-1] * f2[i - k] + f2[k-1] * f1[i - k]) % mod
        c = comb[i - 1][j - 1]
        val = (i + 1) * c % mod * sum_val % mod
        f2[i] = (f2[i] + val) % mod

# Initialize g1 and g2
g1 = [[0] * MAX for _ in range(MAX)]
g2 = [[0] * MAX for _ in range(MAX)]
g1[0][0] = 1

for i in range(1, MAX):
    for j in range(i):
        g1[i][j] = g1[i - 1][j]
        g2[i][j] = g2[i - 1][j]
        for k in range(1, j + 1):
            g1[i][j] = (g1[i][j] + g1[i - k - 1][j - k] * f1[k] % mod * comb[j][k]) % mod
            g2[i][j] = (g2[i][j] + g1[i - k - 1][j - k] * f2[k] % mod * comb[j][k]) % mod
            g2[i][j] = (g2[i][j] + g2[i - k - 1][j - k] * f1[k] % mod * comb[j][k]) % mod
    g1[i][i] = f1[i]
    g2[i][i] = f2[i]

print(g2[n][m])
